```{r}
stopifnot(is.null(attr(check,'status')),!dir.exists(params$figures));dir.create(params$figures,recursive=TRUE)

stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$receipt_sha256)

 tables[[name]]<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$study,paste0(name,'.csv')),receipt$files[[paste0(name,'.csv')]],if(name %in% c('rows','curves','bridge','verified-allocation-diagnostics'))cols(issue='c') else cols())
raw<-readBin(file.path(params$multiplier_report,'receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$multiplier_report,'receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$multiplier_sha256)
mr<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE);stopifnot(mr$status=='PASS')
old<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$multiplier_report,'rows.csv'),mr$files[['rows.csv']],cols(issue='c'))
base_check<-tables$rows |> filter(policy=='BASE') |> inner_join(old |> filter(policy=='long_cash_only'),by='issue',suffix=c('_new','_old'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(nrow(base_check)==784,setequal(tables$rows$issue,old$issue),all(base_check$stake_new==base_check$stake_old),all(abs(base_check$gross_new-base_check$gross_old)<1e-6))
tables$rows<-bind_rows(tables$rows,old |> filter(policy=='BLEND_ADD'))
issue_order<-tables$rows |> distinct(issue,period) |> arrange(period) |> pull(issue)
tables$curves<-strategy_equity_curves(tables$rows |> select(-period),issue_order,100000)
stopifnot(!any(tables$curves$stopped))
tables$summary<-joint_tail_windows(tables$rows,tibble(window='ALL',start=1L,end=784L))
profit_counts<-tables$rows |> group_by(policy) |> summarise(profitable_issues=sum(net>0),.groups='drop')
s<-tables$summary |> filter(window=='ALL') |> left_join(profit_counts,by='policy',relationship='one-to-one');base<-s |> filter(policy=='BASE')
write_csv(s,file.path(params$figures,'comparison-summary.csv'))
raw<-readBin(file.path(params$original_report,'receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$original_report,'receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$original_sha256)
original<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
original_ids<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$original_report,'frozen-plans.csv'),original$files[['frozen-plans.csv']],cols(issue='c',ticket_id='c')) |>
 filter(policy=='long_cash_only') |> distinct(issue,ticket_id) |> mutate(was_original=TRUE)
raw<-readBin(file.path(params$study,'plans-receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$study,'plans-receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(raw,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==receipt$plan_receipt_sha256)
pr<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(raw),simplifyVector=FALSE)
audit<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(params$audit,pr$audit_sha256,cols(issue='c',provider_id='c'))
reticulate::use_python(params$python,required=TRUE)
projection<-reticulate::import('src.joint_grid_rotation_inputs',convert=TRUE)
jobs<-setNames(pr$source_bundles,vapply(pr$source_bundles,`[[`,character(1),'issue'))
novelty<-components<-list()
for(id in names(pr$plan_hashes)) {
 all_tickets<-joint_rotation_read_plan(file.path(params$study,'plans',paste0(id,'.csv')),pr$plan_hashes[[id]])
 z<-all_tickets |> filter(policy %in% c('EXPAND','ROTATE'),copies>0,base_copies==0) |>
 left_join(original_ids |> filter(issue==id),by=c('issue','ticket_id'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(origin=if_else(is.na(was_original),'UNSEEN_ORIGINAL','RESTORED_ORIGINAL')) |>
 group_by(policy,origin) |> summarise(unique_combinations=n(),physical_tickets=sum(copies),.groups='drop')
 novelty[[id]]<-z
 b<-jsonlite::fromJSON(projection$read_rotation_members_json(jobs[[id]]$path,jobs[[id]]$sha256),simplifyVector=FALSE)
 stopifnot(b$issue==id)
 g_labels<-list();ia<-audit |> filter(issue==id)
 for(g in b$sleeves) {
  if(!g$id %in% all_tickets$sleeve_id)next
  fx<-bind_rows(b$fixtures[as.integer(unlist(g$fixture_indices))+1L])
  a<-fx |> select(slot,provider_id,handicap) |> left_join(ia,by=c('slot','provider_id','handicap'),relationship='one-to-one')
  stopifnot(nrow(a)==7,!anyNA(a$actual_direction),!anyNA(a$spf_sp))
  g_labels[[as.character(g$id)]]<-tibble(sleeve_id=g$id,
   actual=sum((match(a$actual_direction,c('W','D','L'))-1L)*3^(6:0))+1L,winning_gross=2*.65*prod(a$spf_sp))
 }
 gl<-if(length(g_labels))bind_rows(g_labels) else tibble(sleeve_id=integer(),actual=integer(),winning_gross=double())
 ledger<-all_tickets |> filter(policy!='BASE') |> left_join(gl,by='sleeve_id',relationship='many-to-one') |>
  mutate(gross=if_else(ticket_col_idx==actual,winning_gross,0))
 components[[id]]<-joint_rotation_components(ledger,2)
}
novelty<-bind_rows(novelty) |> group_by(policy,origin) |> summarise(across(c(unique_combinations,physical_tickets),sum),.groups='drop')
write_csv(novelty,file.path(params$figures,'novelty.csv'))
refined<-bind_rows(components)
check<-refined |> group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(new=sum(net_change),.groups='drop') |>
 full_join(tables$bridge |> group_by(issue,policy) |> summarise(old=sum(net_change),.groups='drop'),by=c('issue','policy'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(!anyNA(check),all(abs(check$new-check$old)<1e-6))
write_csv(refined,file.path(params$figures,'refined-bridge.csv'))
actions<-refined |> group_by(policy,component) |>
 summarise(across(c(stake_change,gross_change,net_change),sum),.groups='drop')
```

本轮固定784期，预算每期1024元、每票2元、本金10万元。ROI分母为实际投入，回款已含一次0.65。
使用完整冻结候选组，保持35格、概率底座和历史信号不变。历史已被观察，结果为研究证据。

- **BASE**：原累计筛弱留现金方案。
- **BLEND_ADD**：上一轮只在好格原票上加倍、不增加覆盖。
- **EXPAND**：原票不减，用余款优先买好格的新组合。
- **ROTATE**：差格减半，资金优先转向好格的新组合。
- **PROB对照**：保持对应方案的删票动作和目标投入，将新增目的地放宽到所有合格格子，按概率排序。

优先不同组，再增加组内不同赛果，最后才加倍。新组最多与现有组重叠5场；新增每份票受每场512元
或原暴露较大值的上限约束。新增票估算回款至少128元。没有合适票则留现金。

```{r}
knitr::kable(s |> transmute(方案=policy,投入=stake,净收益=net,ROI百分比=100*roi,命中期数=hit_issues,盈利期数=profitable_issues,最大回撤=local_drawdown),digits=2)
```

相比BASE：EXPAND净收益变化为 **`r round(s$net[s$policy=='EXPAND']-base$net)`元**，
命中期数变化 **`r s$hit_issues[s$policy=='EXPAND']-base$hit_issues`期**；
ROTATE净收益变化为 **`r round(s$net[s$policy=='ROTATE']-base$net)`元**，
命中期数变化 **`r s$hit_issues[s$policy=='ROTATE']-base$hit_issues`期**。
是否值得采用，需要同时看ROI、回撤和同投入目的地对照，不能只看新增命中。

本轮结论：不将这套网格轮动替换为默认方案。扩覆盖确实增加命中期数，但相对BASE增加约9.29万元投入，
净收益仅增加约777元，边际净ROI约0.84%，且最大回撤增加约5717元。减仓再转投的全期净收益下降，回撤显著放大。
因此“增加命中期数”在本轮并未转化为更好的资金使用效率。扩覆盖增加的777元净收益，剔除贡献最大的3期增量后变为负13485元，改善也缺乏分散性。网格选新增票优于对应的纯概率目的地对照，
也不足以证明值得动用这些资金。结论限于这组固定规则和已观察历史，不推广为所有资金轮动均无效。

新增、删票、倍投三部分单列。NEW仅包含相对BASE新增组合的首份；MULTIPLIED包含旧票和新票的所有第二份。其中RESTORED_ORIGINAL是恢复原JOINT曾买过的票，UNSEEN_ORIGINAL才是原JOINT未购买的票；下表另列两类数量。REMOVED一行表示相对于BASE的资金变化：负回款是放弃的中奖回款；
净收益变化为正才说明删除整体有利。

```{r}
matched<-tables[['verified-allocation-diagnostics']] |> filter(target_stake==comparator_stake) |> select(issue,policy)
paired<-matched |> left_join(tables$rows |> select(issue,policy,stake,net),by=c('issue','policy'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 mutate(comparator=paste0(policy,'_PROB')) |> left_join(tables$rows |> select(issue,comparator=policy,prob_net=net),by=c('issue','comparator'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 group_by(policy) |> summarise(matched_issues=n(),stake=sum(stake),grid_net=sum(net),prob_net=sum(prob_net),difference=grid_net-prob_net,.groups='drop')
knitr::kable(paired,digits=2)
knitr::kable(actions,digits=2)
knitr::kable(novelty)
knitr::kable(tables$concentration,digits=2)

 summarise(新增组合=sum(new_combinations),新增组=sum(new_groups),额外份数=sum(extra_copies),删除票=sum(removed),
 投入不匹配期数=sum(target_stake!=comparator_stake),对照少投金额=sum(target_stake-comparator_stake),.groups='drop'))
```

700期后的曲线使用该窗口起点重新计算收益和回撤，窗口只用于事后诊断。

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
tail<-tables$rows |> filter(period>=700) |> arrange(policy,period) |> group_by(policy) |>
 mutate(relative_net=cumsum(net),local_drawdown=cummax(c(0,relative_net))[-1]-relative_net) |> ungroup()
p3<-tail |> select(policy,period,relative_net,local_drawdown) |>
 pivot_longer(c(relative_net,local_drawdown),names_to='metric',values_to='CNY') |>
 ggplot(aes(period,CNY,colour=policy))+geom_line(linewidth=.6)+facet_wrap(~metric,ncol=1,scales='free_y')+
 theme_minimal()+theme(legend.position='bottom')+labs(title='Issues 700 onward: net and local drawdown',x='Issue index',colour=NULL)
ggsave(file.path(params$figures,'tail-curves.png'),p3,width=12,height=8,dpi=150);p3
```

格子信号来自原购买集合；推广到未买组合属于此次要检验的外推。
模型依旧采用历史可用性时间代理，本轮不能作为真实赛前可执行性认证。

复现顺序为：使用显式参数运行216冻结入口，再运行218结算入口，其中调用
`joint_rotation_receipt(out, repository_root, audit_path, generated_at, evaluation_code)`封存数值输出，再向本报告传入该凭据的SHA-256。
最终验收另包含函数测试、独立重放、干净渲染和Codex review；ANALYSIS_COMPLETE本身不等于审核通过。

```{r}
report_inputs<-list(analysis=list(path=file.path(params$study,'analysis-receipt.json'),sha256=params$receipt_sha256),

 original=list(path=file.path(params$original_report,'receipt.json'),sha256=params$original_sha256),
 audit=list(path=params$audit,sha256=pr$audit_sha256))
joint_rotation_report_receipt(params$figures,params$project_root,report_inputs,report_code,format(Sys.time(),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',tz='UTC'))
```
